source_title: ILO Global Employment Trends for Youth 2024
direct_observation: 13% youth unemployment; 20% NEET; two in three NEET youth are women
evidence_status: high for global scale and gender signal; local routes remain open
next_test: follow named cohort into work quality and care constraints

source_title: ILO Global Employment Trends for Youth regional analysis
direct_observation: school/training, NEET and unemployment conditions vary sharply by income group and region
evidence_status: high for geographic boundary; not a participant-level conversion
next_test: compare urban/rural and origin/destination transition routes

direct_observation: temporary and informal work affect income, hours, safety and legal protection
evidence_status: high for job-quality mechanism; retention and remedy remain open
next_test: link placement records to contract, pay, safety, protection and exit

source_title: ILO youth active labour-market evidence; World Bank Rwanda skills result
unit_or_scope: youth-targeted programmes and one Rwanda industry-led case
direct_observation: skills, entrepreneurship, employment services, wage subsidies and combined programmes have different average effects; one Rwanda case reports employment/self-employment after industry-aligned training
evidence_status: medium; programme effects vary and the case does not prove transferability, retention or job quality
next_test: construct participant/non-participant follow-up with implementation fidelity

direct_observation: study/work combinations and NEET exposure differ; extended absence can reduce experience and skill development
evidence_status: medium-to-high for transition structure; causal pathway and local fit remain open
next_test: measure named school, work, care, guidance and later retention

direct_observation: career guidance, social capital, mentoring and employer information are unevenly distributed
evidence_status: medium; strong mechanism framing, limited named outcome closure
next_test: compare disadvantaged and connected learners’ interview, offer and retention routes
